```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```


```{r}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

C4_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_fa_04_couple_04.sas7bdat")

M4_C0_bornes <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M4_C0_bornes.csv",
                                show_col_types = F)

```


# Corriger données d'identité

```{r}

# Ajouter id_doublon
C4_A1 <- C4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    ),
    sf_conjt_prenom = str_to_upper(sf_conjt_prenom),
    sf_conjt_prenom = replace_when(
      sf_conjt_prenom,
      sf_conjt_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

C4_A2 <- C4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(C4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:fa_couple_cat), -couple_type)

```

# Retirer les colonnes vides

```{r}

empty_cols_C4_A2 <- C4_A2 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(C4_A2))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_C4_A2$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
C4_A3 <- C4_A2 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides))

rm(list = c("empty_cols_C4_A2", "C4_A0", "C4_A1", "C4_A2", "vars_vides"))

```
